platform: Ubuntu 26.04.1 x86_64, NVIDIA RTX 4000 SFF Ada, driver 595.91.07, Rust 1.98.1
method: Three separate processes per policy and scale; CPU/GPU/auto order reversed on round two; five warmups and forty measurements per case; median of process medians and p95s. Setup and CPU-reference verification excluded; cold measures first optimized query for each case. No other benchmark or compilation ran on this host during measurements; shared production-host load was not controlled.
correctness: All runs matched ordered IDs and scores within 1e-5 against generic CPU query execution.
limitations: Synthetic vectors and filters; not end-to-end chat latency or a universal crossover.
First GPU query includes initialization and data upload; broad cold scans were slower than CPU.
Scoped case runs after broad case and can reuse GPU device and column cache.
Automatic policy uses CPU below the configured threshold and GPU above it when available, with CPU fallback.
